source_format: RIFF/WAVE little-endian PCM16, stereo I/Q, data chunk at byte 44
extraction: FLAC was encoded from original little-endian PCM16 in its existing channel order. Decoded PCM was compared byte for byte to the complete original source slice.
selection: Next full 60 seconds immediately following the published [360,420) study. The selection used source metadata and previously reported processing bounds. No current-interval counter, codeword, waveform score or packet reading was used to select it.
prior_external_use: The contributor identified a matching 12:15:02 recording and published whole-capture aggregate results. This interval is locally held out for this study. A previously unseen recording or an independently held secret sample cannot be claimed.

receiver.settings: One cold nominal finite-input Dream pass; Wiener frequency/time interpolation 2/1, modulation metric 0, one MLC iteration; all 720000 pairs from sample zero of this FLAC. Empty primary results are retained.
